repo_workflow_shape: An uncommitted source file was edited inside VS Code while the operator relied on the extension's conversation and revert surfaces.
trigger: The operator asked Codex to find and delete duplicate code.
observed_failure: Codex truncated the file from the wrong location, the extension's revert action failed, and the visible history did not contain a complete recoverable state.
returned_human_burden_detail: The operator manually copied code from conversation history to reconstruct the uncommitted file and had to verify the recovered result.
ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Constrain the edit to the intended duplicate, preserve a complete pre-edit snapshot, and provide a tested reversible recovery path.
minimum_repair: Restore from a verified pre-edit snapshot or version-control checkpoint, then verify the full file before resuming edits.
restart_result: The operator reports a manual reconstruction; the issue remained open at collection time and later comments still described the recovery problem.
evidence_quote_or_exact_location: Issue body sections "Steps to reproduce" and "What actually happened"; short excerpt: "failed to revert changes".
directly_observed_facts: The issue identifies extension version 0.4.46 and a duplicate-code deletion request.

repo_workflow_shape: A bare Git common directory served 115 linked worktrees, and Codex Desktop opened one worktree-backed thread.

observed_failure: All linked worktrees began reading the shared common directory as bare and `git status` failed until the shared setting was removed.
returned_human_burden_detail: The operator diagnosed shared Git configuration, removed the setting, and ran a controlled independent-clone validation before resuming.
ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Preflight the common-directory topology, avoid non-atomic shared configuration mutation, and roll back the exact setting if validation fails.
minimum_repair: Unset `extensions.worktreeConfig` in the shared common directory and verify every linked worktree reads the original bare setting.
restart_result: The issue reports immediate restoration of all linked worktrees after the setting was unset; no source loss occurred, and the product issue remained open.
evidence_quote_or_exact_location: Issue body sections "Reproduction", "Evidence", "Recovery", and "Controlled validation"; exact command location includes `git config --unset extensions.worktreeConfig`.
directly_observed_facts: The issue records the affected topology as one bare common directory and 115 linked worktrees.
Before-and-after Git commands and configuration values are included.
Unsetting the shared setting restored the worktrees immediately, and an ordinary-clone control validated the isolated case.
inferences: The four what-broke classes and two burden classes are analyst mappings.
The count of 115 worktrees measures affected repository surfaces, not human burden.
deduplication_note: One shared-configuration mutation worldline across 115 worktrees; the worktrees are not counted as separate incidents.

repo_workflow_shape: A parent agent spawned three bounded child agents and waited for their completion payloads.
trigger: The parent delegated independent work and entered repeated bounded waits for results.
observed_failure: The child agents stopped without returning their results to the parent; later implementation workers remained running without messages or edits until interrupted.
returned_human_burden_detail: The operator inspected rollout state and lifecycle behavior after four explicit wait windows returned no usable child result.

burden_quantity.basis: sum of the four explicit 30, 60, 90, and 180 second parent wait windows in the first reproduction; not a measure of continuous human labor

ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Guarantee exactly-once child-result delivery or a terminal failure payload and release delegated resources after completion.
minimum_repair: Return a durable terminal payload to the parent before child shutdown and expose lifecycle state that distinguishes completed, failed, interrupted, and orphaned work.
restart_result: The issue remained open; a later reproduction reported the same no-result state and manual interruption rather than a verified repair.
evidence_quote_or_exact_location: Issue body reproduction and rollout-reference sections; wait windows are listed as 30s, 60s, 90s, and 180s.
directly_observed_facts: The first reproduction lists three child agents and four timed waits with no parent-visible result.
The issue links local rollout evidence and describes terminal lifecycle states.
A later reproduction states that implementation workers produced no message or edit before interruption.
inferences: The 360-second quantity is orchestration delay explicitly bounded by wait calls, not total human effort.
What-broke and returned-burden labels are analyst mappings.
deduplication_note: The initial scouts and later implementation workers are retained as repeat evidence for one child-result lifecycle mechanism, not separate cases.

repo_workflow_shape: A repository with uncommitted formalization work was being rebased and pushed through an agent-operated shell.
trigger: After rebase conflicts, the agent attempted to synchronize with the remote branch.
observed_failure: The agent ran `git reset --hard origin/main` without first preserving the dirty worktree, making 42 lemmas, 10 tests, documentation, and safety fixes disappear from the working tree.
returned_human_burden_detail: The operator had to diagnose the destructive reset, recover through reflog, and verify the restored work.
ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Inspect dirty state, preserve uncommitted work on a stash or backup branch, and require explicit authorization before a destructive reset.
minimum_repair: Recover the pre-reset state from reflog, create a durable checkpoint, and re-run repository validation before any further synchronization.
restart_result: The issue reports that the files remained recoverable through Git reflog, so permanent data loss was avoided; the issue later closed as not planned without a verified product repair.
evidence_quote_or_exact_location: Issue body incident transcript and recovery update; exact destructive command: `git reset --hard origin/main`.
directly_observed_facts: The issue lists 42 lemmas, 10 tests, documentation, and safety fixes as disappearing from the working tree.
The author states that reflog made the files recoverable.
The issue closed as not planned.
inferences: The counts describe affected artifacts, not returned-human-burden quantities.
Rollback, Revalidation, and the what-broke classes are analyst mappings.
deduplication_note: One destructive-reset worldline; the listed artifact categories are consequences of the same command, not separate incidents.

observed_failure: The subagent executed recursive deletion of the worktree directory without a permission prompt, leaving four Git worktrees prunable and their directories missing.

deduplication_note: One unauthorized deletion worldline affecting four worktrees; the worktrees are not separate cases.

observed_failure: The editor tried to express full-file deletion as an empty search-and-replace, failed exact matching three times, and repeated until the operator stopped the process with Ctrl-C.
returned_human_burden_detail: The operator had to terminate the repeated failed edit loop manually.
ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Use a dedicated safe file-deletion operation, cap identical retries, and return an actionable failure state instead of looping.
minimum_repair: Stop after the first repeated exact-match failure, verify the target path, and perform a version-controlled removal with an explicit changed-file receipt.

repo_workflow_shape: An agent handled a review follow-up on an existing pull-request branch whose earlier implementation commit already contained the main code change.
trigger: The agent made and committed the requested README follow-up, then evaluated task completion against only the new commit's diff from the branch tip.
observed_failure: Because the narrow diff contained documentation but not the earlier code, the completion check declared the request unresolved, skipped the push, and discarded the otherwise correct incremental commit.
returned_human_burden_detail: The review workflow had to be re-evaluated because the agent judged the cumulative pull request from the wrong comparison base.
ai_execution_agent_should_have_owned: Evaluate the cumulative pull-request diff against the target branch or scope completion to the follow-up request, then preserve and push a valid incremental commit.
minimum_repair: Re-evaluate from the merge base with the target branch, restore the discarded documentation commit if valid, and push only after cumulative validation passes.
restart_result: The issue closed as not planned after staleness handling; no verified repair or successful restart is recorded.
evidence_quote_or_exact_location: Issue body sections "Root cause" and "Concrete example"; short excerpt: "commit was discarded".
directly_observed_facts: The issue identifies the completion check's comparison base as the current branch tip.
It binds a concrete pull-request follow-up where an earlier commit carried code and the new commit carried documentation.
The agent skipped push and discarded the new commit after its own completion evaluation.
inferences: Restartability, Trust, Evidence Chain, Branch Integrity, and Revalidation are analyst mappings.
The proposed merge-base repair was not verified in the issue.
deduplication_note: One wrong-diff-base completion worldline; the concrete pull request is evidence for this issue rather than a second case.
